383	    def swing_channels(self, side, i, t):
384	        t0, D, spl, extra = self.swing_splines(side, i)
385	        return self._channels(side, spl, extra, (np.asarray(t, dtype=float) - t0) / D)
386	
387	    def _channels(self, side, spl, extra, s):
388	        c = np.stack([f(s) for f in spl], -1)
389	        sign = self.legs[side].sign
390	        c[:, 1] += sign * self.p["hip_ab_swing"] * bump(s, 3.0, 3.0)
391	        for kind, s_pk, amt in extra:    # guard corrections (see _clear_swing)
392	            w = np.exp(-((s - s_pk) / 0.22) ** 2) * bump(s, 2.0, 2.0) / bump(np.array(s_pk), 2.0, 2.0)
393	            if kind == "lift":           # more knee and hip flexion
394	                c[:, 3] += amt * w
395	                c[:, 0] -= 0.6 * amt * w
396	            else:                        # more hip abduction (foot further out)
397	                c[:, 1] += sign * amt * w
398	        return c
399	
400	    def foot_frames(self, side, t, ch):
401	        """World ankle rotation and position for leg channels ch (n, 8) at times t."""
402	        leg = self.legs[side]
403	        P0, W0 = self.pelvis(t)
404	        Wh = W0 @ from_euler_xzy(ch[:, 0:3])
405	        Ph = P0 + mv(W0, leg.hip_off)
406	        Wk = Wh @ rx(ch[:, 3])
407	        Pk = Ph + mv(Wh, leg.a)
408	        return Wk @ from_euler_xzy(ch[:, 4:7]), Pk + mv(Wk, leg.b)
409	
410	    def sole_height(self, side, t, ch):
411	        """Lowest of a few sole points (heel, sole edges, and the toe tip on the toe segment)
412	        above the floor for leg channels ch (n, 8) at times t."""
413	        leg = self.legs[side]
414	        Wa, Pa = self.foot_frames(side, t, ch)
415	        pts = sole_points(side)[:4] - J[leg.ankle]
416	        y = Pa[:, None, 1] + np.einsum("nj,kj->nk", Wa[:, 1, :], pts)
417	        Wt = Wa @ rx(ch[:, 7])
418	        tip = sole_points(side)[4] - J[leg.toe]
419	        y_toe = Pa[:, 1] + Wa[:, 1, :] @ (J[leg.toe] - J[leg.ankle]) + Wt[:, 1, :] @ tip
420	        return np.minimum(y.min(1), y_toe) - FLOOR
421	
422	    def _other_foot_outline(self, side, tm):
423	        """Floor outline (k, 2) of the other foot if it is planted at time tm, else None."""
424	        other = "R" if side == "L" else "L"
425	        io, on = self.lookup(other, [tm])
426	        if not on[0]:
427	            return None
428	        Fo, ao, _ = self.stance_foot_pose(other, int(io[0]), [tm])
429	        return (ao[0] + mv(Fo[0], foot_outline(other) - J[self.legs[other].ankle]))[:, [0, 2]]
430	
431	    def _clear_swing(self, side, sw, gap=0.035):
432	        """Guards for a walking swing, as a person lifts the foot a little more or swings it a
433	        little wider when needed:
434	          * toe clearance: if the swinging foot would pass closer to the floor than swing_clear
435	            in mid-swing (where it passes the standing leg), add a smooth bump of knee and hip
436	            flexion where it is lowest;
437	          * foot clearance: if it would pass closer than gap to the planted foot (tight turns),
438	            add a smooth bump of hip abduction there."""
439	        t0, D, spl, extra = sw
440	        s = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 61)
441	        tt = t0 + s * D
442	        # clearance wanted: none at lift-off and touch-down, swing_clear where the foot passes
443	        # the standing leg
444	        want = self.p["swing_clear"] * np.clip(np.minimum((s - 0.04) / 0.21, (0.92 - s) / 0.07), 0.0, 1.0)
445	        mid = (s > 0.04) & (s < 0.92)
446	        po = self._other_foot_outline(side, t0 + 0.5 * D)
447	        pts = foot_outline(side) - J[self.legs[side].ankle]
448	        for _ in range(5):
449	            ch = self._channels(side, spl, extra, s)
450	            h = self.sole_height(side, tt, ch)
451	            deficit = np.where(mid, want - h, -1.0)
452	            i = int(np.argmax(deficit))
453	            lift = sum(e[2] for e in extra if e[0] == "lift")
454	            done = True
455	            if deficit[i] >= 0.001 and lift < 10.0 * DEG:
456	                extra.append(("lift", float(s[i]), float(deficit[i] / 0.22 + 1.0 * DEG)))
457	                done = False
458	            if po is not None:
459	                Wa, Pa = self.foot_frames(side, tt, ch)
460	                pw = (Pa[:, None, :] + np.einsum("nij,kj->nki", Wa, pts))[:, :, [0, 2]]
461	                d = np.linalg.norm(pw[:, :, None, :] - po[None, None, :, :], axis=-1).min(axis=(1, 2))
462	                short = np.where((s > 0.1) & (s < 0.9), gap - d, -1.0)
463	                i = int(np.argmax(short))
464	                wide = sum(e[2] for e in extra if e[0] == "abd")
465	                if short[i] >= 0.002 and wide < 8.0 * DEG:
466	                    extra.append(("abd", float(np.clip(s[i], 0.25, 0.75)), float(short[i] / 0.8 + 0.5 * DEG)))
467	                    done = False
468	            if done:
469	                break
470	
471	    # ================================================================== stepping swing
472	    def shuffle_path(self, side, i):
473	        """Foot path of a small step from plant i to plant i+1: the ankle moves on a cubic
474	        Hermite curve that leaves and arrives with the stance foot's own velocity, the foot
475	        turns smoothly to its new heading, and the path is lifted so that the lowest point of
476	        the sole clears the floor by turn_lift in mid-swing (and never touches it)."""
477	        key = ("shuffle", side, i)
478	        if key in self._swing_cache:
479	            return self._swing_cache[key]
480	        p = self.p
481	        leg = self.legs[side]
482	        tab = self.tab[side]
483	        t0, t1 = float(tab["t_off"][i]), float(tab["t_on"][i + 1])
484	        D = t1 - t0
485	        h = 2e-3
486	        F0, a0, toe0 = self.stance_foot_pose(side, i, [t0, t0 - h])
487	        F1, a1, toe1 = self.stance_foot_pose(side, i + 1, [t1, t1 + h])
488	        y0 = yaw_of(F0[0])
489	        y1 = y0 + wrap(yaw_of(F1[0]) - y0)
490	        pd0, pd1 = foot_pitch(F0), foot_pitch(F1)
491	        s = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 81)
492	        yaw = y0 + (y1 - y0) * smootherstep(s)
493	        pit = hermite(s, pd0[0], (pd0[0] - pd0[1]) / h * D, pd1[0], (pd1[1] - pd1[0]) / h * D)
494	        ank = hermite(s, a0[0], (a0[0] - a0[1]) / h * D, a1[0], (a1[1] - a1[0]) / h * D)
495	        F = ry(yaw) @ rx(pit)
496	        pts = sole_points(side) - J[leg.ankle]
497	        world = ank[:, None, :] + np.einsum("nij,kj->nki", F, pts)
498	        minh = world[:, :, 1].min(1) - FLOOR
499	        clr = p["turn_lift"] * bump(s, 2.0, 2.0)
500	        lift = np.maximum(clr - minh, 0.0)
501	        lift = np.maximum(gaussian_filter1d(lift, 3.0, mode="nearest"), lift)
502	        lift *= smoothstep(s / 0.06) * smoothstep((1.0 - s) / 0.06)
503	        ank = ank.copy()
504	        ank[:, 1] += lift
505	        ank = self._clear_other_foot(side, t0, D, s, F, ank)
506	        toe = toe0[0] * (1.0 - smoothstep(s / 0.4)) + toe1[0] * smoothstep((s - 0.6) / 0.4)
507	        out = (t0, D, s, yaw, pit, ank, toe)
508	        self._swing_cache[key] = out
509	        return out
510	
511	    def _clear_other_foot(self, side, t0, D, s, F, ank, gap=0.04):
512	        """Push the path of a small step sideways, away from the planted foot, wherever the two
513	        sole outlines would come closer than gap (horizontally)."""
514	        po = self._other_foot_outline(side, t0 + 0.5 * D)
515	        if po is None:
516	            return ank
517	        pts = foot_outline(side) - J[self.legs[side].ankle]
518	        env = bump(s, 2.0, 2.0)
519	        for _ in range(3):
520	            pw = (ank[:, None, :] + np.einsum("nij,kj->nki", F, pts))[:, :, [0, 2]]
521	            d = np.linalg.norm(pw[:, :, None, :] - po[None, None, :, :], axis=-1).min(axis=(1, 2))
522	            need = gaussian_filter1d(np.maximum(gap - d, 0.0), 3.0, mode="nearest") * env
523	            if need.max() < 0.002:
524	                break
525	            away = pw.mean(1) - po.mean(0)
526	            away /= np.linalg.norm(away, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
527	            ank = ank.copy()
528	            ank[:, 0] += 1.3 * need * away[:, 0]
529	            ank[:, 2] += 1.3 * need * away[:, 1]
530	        return ank
531	
532	    def shuffle_foot(self, side, i, t):
533	        t0, D, s, yaw, pit, ank, toe = self.shuffle_path(side, i)
534	        u = np.clip((np.asarray(t, dtype=float) - t0) / D, 0.0, 1.0)
535	        F = ry(np.interp(u, s, yaw)) @ rx(np.interp(u, s, pit))
536	        A = np.stack([np.interp(u, s, ank[:, k]) for k in range(3)], -1)
537	        return F, A, np.interp(u, s, toe)
538	
539	    # ================================================================== whole clip
540	    def pose_rotations(self, t):
541	        """Pelvis position (n, 3) and local rotations R (n, 22, 3, 3) at times t."""
542	        t = np.asarray(t, dtype=float)
543	        n = len(t)
544	        P0, W0 = self.pelvis(t)
545	        R = np.tile(np.eye(3), (n, NJ, 1, 1))
546	        R[:, 0] = W0
547	        self.diag = {}
548	        for side, leg in self.legs.items():
549	            idx, contact = self.lookup(side, t)
550	            i = np.nonzero(contact)[0]
551	            if len(i):
552	                Rh, th, Ra, toe, q = self.stance_pose(side, idx[i], t[i])
553	                R[i, leg.hip], R[i, leg.knee], R[i, leg.ankle], R[i, leg.toe] = Rh, rx(th), Ra, rx(toe)
554	                self.diag[side + "_q"] = q
555	            sw = np.nonzero(~contact)[0]
556	            for k in np.unique(idx[sw]):
557	                i = sw[idx[sw] == k]
558	                kind = self.plan.plants[side][k + 1].step.kind
559	                if kind == "walk":
560	                    c = self.swing_channels(side, int(k), t[i])
561	                    R[i, leg.hip] = from_euler_xzy(c[:, 0:3])
562	                    R[i, leg.knee] = rx(c[:, 3])
563	                    R[i, leg.ankle] = from_euler_xzy(c[:, 4:7])
564	                    R[i, leg.toe] = rx(c[:, 7])
565	                else:
566	                    F, A, toe = self.shuffle_foot(side, int(k), t[i])
567	                    Rh, th, Ra, _ = leg.ik(P0[i], W0[i], F, A)
568	                    R[i, leg.hip], R[i, leg.knee], R[i, leg.ankle], R[i, leg.toe] = Rh, rx(th), Ra, rx(toe)
569	        for j, M in upper_body(self, t, W0).items():
570	            R[:, j] = M
571	        return P0, R
572	
573	    def generate(self, n_frames, fps):
574	        t = np.arange(n_frames) / float(fps)
575	        P0, R = self.pose_rotations(t)
576	        return dict(fps=int(fps), transl=P0 - J[0], global_orient=to_rotvec(R[:, 0]),
577	                    body_pose=to_rotvec(R[:, 1:]))
578	
579	
580	def calibrate(params=None):
581	    """Pelvis offset c_walk and static pelvic obliquity roll0 for steady straight walking.
582	
583	    The SMPL-X skeleton is slightly asymmetric, and where the pelvis sits relative to the feet
584	    follows from the balance model; with the wrong values the required pelvis height would
585	    jump when the leading leg changes.  Newton iteration on (c_walk, roll0) makes both
586	    hand-overs continuous."""
587	    from .path import WalkLine
588	    from .plan import PlanBuilder
589	    q = make_params(params)
590	    q.update(var=0.0, c_walk=0.0, roll0=0.0)
591	    line = WalkLine([0.0, 0.0], 0.0, [{"type": "straight", "length": 40.0}])
592	    b = PlanBuilder(q)
593	    b.stand([0.0, 0.0], 0.0)
594	    b.wait(0.5)
595	    b.walk(line, stop=False, t_end=8.0, first="R")
596	    plan = b.finish(8.0)
597	    body = Body(plan, (0.0, 8.0), solve_height=False)
598	    st = plan.steps
599	    j = next(k for k, s in enumerate(st) if s.t_hs > 5.0)
600	    A, B, C = st[j - 1], st[j], st[j + 1]      # three consecutive touch-downs
601	    eps = 1e-6
602	
603	    def yr(step, t):
604	        idx = step.plant_index
605	        u, lam = body.u_lam(step.side, [idx], [t])
606	        return body.y_required(step.side, [idx], [t], u, lam)[0]
607	
608	    def mismatch(x):
609	        q["c_walk"], q["roll0"] = float(x[0]), float(x[1])
610	        return np.array([yr(A, B.t_hs - eps) - yr(B, B.t_hs), yr(B, C.t_hs - eps) - yr(C, C.t_hs)])
611	
612	    x = np.array([0.0, 0.0])
613	    for _ in range(15):
614	        m = mismatch(x)
615	        if np.max(np.abs(m)) < 1e-7:
616	            break
617	        Jm = np.zeros((2, 2))
618	        for i in range(2):
619	            dx = np.zeros(2)
620	            dx[i] = 1e-4
621	            Jm[:, i] = (mismatch(x + dx) - m) / 1e-4
622	        x = x - np.linalg.solve(Jm, m)
623	    return float(x[0]), float(x[1])

"""The body: from a footstep plan to SMPL-X joint rotations.

Pipeline (each stage only needs the previous ones):
  1. Balance (balance.py): centre of pressure from the plants, centre of mass from the
     inverted pendulum, the pelvis heading program, and the lean against sustained
     accelerations (bends, starts, stops).
  2. Pelvis: horizontal position = centre of mass; heading from the plan plus the gait's
     pelvis rotation; tilt (pelvic drop, forward tilt, lean); all gait oscillations are
     scaled by the step size, so they fade in when starting and out when stopping.
  3. Pelvis height: for every weight-bearing leg the height that gives its target knee angle
     is computed in closed form; the highest smooth curve that never exceeds the lowest of
     these is fitted (asymmetric least squares).
     Every touch-down's requirement is applied to the samples on both sides of it, so the
     curve cannot overshoot between samples when a leg takes the weight.
  4. Legs.  Stance: foot rockers + analytic IK (a planted foot cannot slide); when the body
     has turned over a planted foot (corners), the foot pivots on the forefoot before toe off.
     Swing: walking steps are clamped cubic splines in joint space (normal swing kinematics),
     with guards that add knee/hip flexion where the toes would pass too low and hip
     abduction where the foot would pass too close to the planted one; small steps on the
     spot move the foot along a lifted path in space (kept clear of the floor and of the
     other foot) and use IK.
  5. Upper body (upper_body.py).
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse as sp
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
from scipy.sparse.linalg import spsolve

from .balance import cop_path, lipm_com, smoothed_acceleration
from .gait import GRAVITY, KNEE_TGT, knee_target, make_params
from .legs import Leg
from .path import hdir, lnorm
from .plan import SIDES
from .rotations import (DEG, bump, euler_xzy, from_euler_xzy, hermite, mv, rx, ry, rz,
                        smootherstep, smoothstep, to_rotvec, wrap, yaw_of)
from .skeleton import FLOOR, J, NJ, foot_outline, sole_points
from .upper_body import upper_body

DT_GRID = 1.0 / 120.0


def fit_below(y, lam, margin, iters=60):
    """Smooth curve z that stays below y - margin and is as close to it as possible:
    minimise sum(w (z - y')^2) + lam * sum((D3 z)^2), with large weights w where z would exceed
    y' = y - margin (asymmetric least squares).  Finally shifted down by any remaining excess."""
    n = len(y)
    D = sp.diags([-1.0, 3.0, -3.0, 1.0], [0, 1, 2, 3], shape=(n - 3, n))
    P = lam * (D.T @ D)
    target = y - margin
    w = np.ones(n)
    z = target
    for _ in range(iters):
        z = spsolve((sp.diags(w) + P).tocsc(), w * target)
        w_new = np.maximum(w, np.where(z > target, 1e5, 1.0))   # once active, stays active
        if np.array_equal(w_new, w):
            break
        w = w_new
    return z - max(0.0, float(np.max(z - target)))


def foot_pitch(F):
    """Pitch (positive = toes down) of foot orientations F = Ry(yaw) Rx(pitch)."""
    f = F[..., :, 2]
    return np.arctan2(-f[..., 1], np.hypot(f[..., 0], f[..., 2]))


class Body:
    def __init__(self, plan, window, solve_height=True):
        self.plan = plan
        self.p = plan.p
        p = self.p
        self.legs = {s: Leg(s) for s in SIDES}
        th0 = {s: self.legs[s].straight_knee for s in SIDES}
        self.knee_offset = {s: p["knee_geo"] * (th0[s] - 0.5 * (th0["L"] + th0["R"])) for s in SIDES}
        self.t_a, self.t_b = window
        self._balance()
        self._tables()
        self._swing_cache = {}
        if solve_height:
            self._solve_height()

    # ================================================================== plant tables
    def _tables(self):
        self.tab = {}
        for side in SIDES:
            pl = self.plan.plants[side]
            leg = self.legs[side]
            yaw = np.array([P.yaw for P in pl])
            Fy = ry(yaw)
            c_flat, tip_flat = leg.flat_foot(np.array([P.xz for P in pl]), Fy)
            self.tab[side] = dict(
                t_on=np.array([P.t_on for P in pl]), t_off=np.array([P.t_off for P in pl]),
                Fy=Fy, fwd=Fy[:, :, 2].copy(), c_flat=c_flat, tip_flat=tip_flat,
                alpha=np.array([P.alpha for P in pl]), push=np.array([P.push for P in pl]),
                pivot=self._pivots(side, pl))

    def _pivots(self, side, plants):
        """Yaw by which each plant pivots on the ball of the foot before toe off: a share of
        the misalignment between the foot and the body heading at toe off (beyond the normal
        toe-out and pivot_free), so that the leg is not twisted and over-stretched when the
        body has turned over a planted foot (corners, turns)."""
        p = self.p
        out = np.zeros(len(plants))
        sg = 1.0 if side == "L" else -1.0
        for i, P in enumerate(plants):
            if not P.lifts or P.lift.kind != "walk":
                continue
            ex = float(wrap(self.psi([P.t_off])[0] + sg * p["toe_out"] - P.yaw))
            mag = max(0.0, abs(ex) - p["pivot_free"]) * p["pivot_gain"]
            out[i] = np.sign(ex) * min(mag, p["pivot_max"])
        return out

    def lookup(self, side, t):
        """Index of the current (or last) plant of a foot, and whether it is on the floor."""
        tab = self.tab[side]
        t = np.asarray(t, dtype=float)
        idx = np.clip(np.searchsorted(tab["t_on"], t, side="right") - 1, 0, len(tab["t_on"]) - 1)
        return idx, t < tab["t_off"][idx]

    def gather(self, side, idx):
        tab = self.tab[side]
        idx = np.asarray(idx, dtype=int)
        return {k: tab[k][idx] for k in ("Fy", "fwd", "c_flat", "tip_flat", "alpha", "push", "pivot")}

    def u_lam(self, side, idx, t):
        idx = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(idx, dtype=int))
        t = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(t, dtype=float))
        u = np.empty(len(t))
        lam = np.empty(len(t))
        plants = self.plan.plants[side]
        for i in np.unique(idx):
            m = idx == i
            u[m] = plants[i].u(t[m])
            lam[m] = plants[i].lam_at(t[m])
        return u, lam

    # ================================================================== balance
    def _balance(self):
        p, plan = self.p, self.plan
        t0 = min(plan.t_first - 2.0, self.t_a - 1.0)
        t1 = max(plan.t_last + 2.0, self.t_b + 1.0)
        n = int(np.ceil((t1 - t0) / DT_GRID)) + 1
        tg = t0 + np.arange(n) * DT_GRID
        e = plan.step_env(tg)
        g = plan.size_env(tg)
        cop0 = cop_path(plan, tg)
        com0, omega = lipm_com(tg, cop0, p["com_height"])
        psi0 = plan.heading(tg, com0)
        cop = cop_path(plan, tg, dict(heading=psi0, weight=1.0 - e))
        com, _ = lipm_com(tg, cop, p["com_height"])
        psi = gaussian_filter1d(plan.heading(tg, com), 0.04 / DT_GRID, mode="nearest")
        acc = smoothed_acceleration(com, cop, omega, DT_GRID, p["lean_sigma"])
        a_fwd = np.sum(acc * hdir(psi), -1)
        a_lat = np.sum(acc * lnorm(psi), -1)
        self.grid = dict(t=tg, cop=cop, com=com, psi=psi, g=g, e=e,
                         lean_lat=np.clip(p["lean_gain"] * np.arctan(a_lat / GRAVITY),
                                          -p["lean_max"], p["lean_max"]),
                         lean_fwd=np.arctan(a_fwd / GRAVITY))
        self.omega = omega
        self._com = CubicSpline(tg, com)
        self._psi = CubicSpline(tg, psi)

    def _gi(self, key, t):
        G = self.grid
        return np.interp(t, G["t"], G[key])

    def com(self, t):
        G = self.grid["t"]
        return self._com(np.clip(t, G[0], G[-1]))

    def psi(self, t):
        G = self.grid["t"]
        return self._psi(np.clip(t, G[0], G[-1]))

    def envelopes(self, t):
        """Gait phase, step size g and stepping envelope e at times t."""
        return self.plan.phase(t), self._gi("g", t), self._gi("e", t)

    def lean(self, t):
        return self._gi("lean_lat", t), self._gi("lean_fwd", t)

    # ================================================================== pelvis
    def pelvis(self, t, y=None):
        """Pelvis joint position P0 (n, 3) and orientation W0 (n, 3, 3) at times t."""
        p = self.p
        t = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(t, dtype=float))
        ph, g, e = self.envelopes(t)
        gc = np.minimum(g, 1.0)
        psi = self.psi(t)
        lean_lat, _ = self.lean(t)
        xz = self.com(t) + (p["c_walk"] * gc)[:, None] * hdir(psi)
        if y is None:
            y = self.height(t)
        P0 = np.stack([xz[:, 0], J[0, 1] + y, xz[:, 1]], -1)
        yaw = psi - p["yaw_amp"] * g * np.cos(2 * np.pi * (ph + 0.02))
        a_roll = e * (0.4 + 0.6 * gc)
        roll = p["roll_amp"] * a_roll * (np.sin(2 * np.pi * (ph + 0.03)) + 0.15 * np.sin(6 * np.pi * (ph + 0.03)))
        roll = roll + p["roll0"] - p["pelvis_lean"] * lean_lat
        pitch = (p["pitch_stand"] + (p["pitch_mean"] - p["pitch_stand"]) * gc
                 + p["pitch_amp"] * g * np.cos(4 * np.pi * (ph - 0.45)))
        W0 = ry(yaw) @ rx(pitch) @ rz(roll)
        return P0, W0

    def height(self, t):
        tg = self._y.x
        return self._y(np.clip(t, tg[0], tg[-1]))

    # ================================================================== pelvis height
    def y_required(self, side, idx, t, u, lam):
        """Pelvis height offset that gives the target knee flexion of a weight-bearing leg
        (closed form: the target knee angle fixes the hip-ankle distance)."""
        leg = self.legs[side]
        t = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(t, dtype=float))
        _, ank, _ = leg.stance_foot(self.gather(side, idx), u, self.p)
        P0, W0 = self.pelvis(t, y=np.zeros(len(t)))
        hip = P0 + mv(W0, leg.hip_off)
        d = leg.distance_from_knee(knee_target(u, lam, self.p) * DEG + self.knee_offset[side])
        dv = hip - ank
        h2 = dv[:, 0] ** 2 + dv[:, 2] ** 2
        return -dv[:, 1] + np.sqrt(np.maximum(d * d - h2, 0.0))

    def _solve_height(self):
        p = self.p
        tg = np.arange(self.t_a, self.t_b, 1.0 / p["y_rate"])
        yreq = np.full(len(tg), np.inf)
        for side in SIDES:
            idx, contact = self.lookup(side, tg)
            u, lam = self.u_lam(side, idx, tg)
            role = contact & (u < 0.5)
            i = np.nonzero(role)[0]
            if len(i):
                yreq[i] = np.minimum(yreq[i], self.y_required(side, idx[i], tg[i], u[i], lam[i]))
        # the requirement drops sharply when a leg takes the weight: make the samples on both
        # sides of each touch-down respect it, so the fitted curve cannot overshoot in between
        dt = 1.0 / p["y_rate"]
        for side in SIDES:
            t_on = self.tab[side]["t_on"]
            for i in np.nonzero((t_on > tg[0] + dt) & (t_on < tg[-1] - dt))[0]:
                tt = np.array([t_on[i], t_on[i] + 0.5 * dt])
                u, lam = self.u_lam(side, [i, i], tt)
                y = self.y_required(side, [i, i], tt, u, lam).min()
                j = np.searchsorted(tg, t_on[i])
                yreq[j - 1:j + 1] = np.minimum(yreq[j - 1:j + 1], y)
        ok = np.isfinite(yreq)
        if not ok.all():
            yreq[~ok] = np.interp(tg[~ok], tg[ok], yreq[ok])
        yfit = fit_below(yreq, p["y_lambda"] * (p["y_rate"] / 120.0) ** 6, p["y_margin"])
        self.y_samples = (tg, yreq, yfit)
        self._y = CubicSpline(tg, yfit)

    # ================================================================== stance
    def stance_pose(self, side, idx, t):
        leg = self.legs[side]
        t = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(t, dtype=float))
        idx = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(idx, dtype=int))
        u, _ = self.u_lam(side, idx, t)
        P0, W0 = self.pelvis(t)
        hip = P0 + mv(W0, leg.hip_off)
        F, ank, toe = leg.stance_foot(self.gather(side, idx), u, self.p, hip)
        Rh, th, Ra, q = leg.ik(P0, W0, F, ank)
        return Rh, th, Ra, toe, q

    def stance_foot_pose(self, side, idx, t):
        leg = self.legs[side]
        t = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(t, dtype=float))
        idx = np.full(len(t), idx, dtype=int)
        u, _ = self.u_lam(side, idx, t)
        P0, W0 = self.pelvis(t)
        hip = P0 + mv(W0, leg.hip_off)
        return leg.stance_foot(self.gather(side, idx), u, self.p, hip)

    def stance_channels(self, side, idx, t):
        """Channels: hip (X, Z, Y), knee, ankle (X, Z, Y), toe."""
        Rh, th, Ra, toe, _ = self.stance_pose(side, idx, t)
        return np.concatenate([euler_xzy(Rh), th[:, None], euler_xzy(Ra), toe[:, None]], -1)

    # ================================================================== walking swing
    def leg_points(self, side, t, ch):
        """World heel-circle centre and foot pitch for leg channels ch (m, 8) at time t."""
        leg = self.legs[side]
        m = len(ch)
        P0, W0 = self.pelvis(np.full(m, t))
        Wh = W0 @ from_euler_xzy(ch[:, 0:3])
        Ph = P0 + mv(W0, leg.hip_off)
        Wk = Wh @ rx(ch[:, 3])
        Pk = Ph + mv(Wh, leg.a)
        Wa = Wk @ from_euler_xzy(ch[:, 4:7])
        Pa = Pk + mv(Wk, leg.b)
        heel = Pa + mv(Wa, leg.heel_c - J[leg.ankle])
        fwd = Wa[:, :, 2]
        return heel, np.arctan2(-fwd[:, 1], np.hypot(fwd[:, 0], fwd[:, 2]))

    def approach_velocity(self, side, idx, t1, c1, v_app):
        """Joint velocities just before heel strike for a rigid-leg approach: the knee is
        momentarily still, the foot keeps its pitch, and the hip moves so that the heel travels
        forward over the floor at v_app (m/s) without sideways drift.  The heel then comes
        down at whatever speed this geometry gives."""
        h = 2e-3
        heel1, pitch1 = self.leg_points(side, t1, c1[None])
        fwd = self.tab[side]["fwd"][idx]
        lat = np.array([fwd[2], 0.0, -fwd[0]])
        sel = [0, 1, 4]            # hip flexion, hip ab/adduction, ankle flexion

        def resid(X):              # X (m, 3) candidate velocities -> residuals (m, 3)
            V = np.zeros((len(X), 8))
            V[:, sel] = X
            heel0, pitch0 = self.leg_points(side, t1 - h, c1[None] - h * V)
            vel = (heel1 - heel0) / h
            return np.stack([vel @ fwd - v_app, vel @ lat, (pitch1 - pitch0) / h], -1)

        x = np.zeros(3)
        eps = 1e-4
        for _ in range(10):
            X = np.vstack([x, x + eps * np.eye(3)])
            Rr = resid(X)
            r = Rr[0]
            if np.max(np.abs(r)) < 1e-9:
                break
            Jm = (Rr[1:] - r).T / eps
            x = x - np.linalg.solve(Jm, r)
        v = np.zeros(8)
        v[sel] = x
        return v

    def swing_splines(self, side, i):
        """Per-channel clamped cubic splines over the swing from plant i to plant i+1
        (s in [0, 1]).

        Signs: hip X < 0 is flexion, knee > 0 is flexion, ankle X < 0 is dorsiflexion,
        toe < 0 is extension.  Start: angle and velocity of the stance leg at toe-off.  End:
        the stance pose at the next heel strike with the rigid-leg approach velocity.  Via
        points follow normal swing kinematics, scaled down for short steps: knee flexion peaks
        (~60 deg for a full step) at ~30 % of swing and is almost straight just before
        contact; hip flexion peaks late in swing and retracts slightly into contact; the ankle
        keeps plantarflexing briefly after toe-off, then dorsiflexes to about neutral.  Hip
        ab/adduction and rotation, which re-orient the foot for the next footprint, go smoothly
        from start to end."""
        key = ("walk", side, i)
        if key in self._swing_cache:
            return self._swing_cache[key]
        p = self.p
        tab = self.tab[side]
        t0, t1 = float(tab["t_off"][i]), float(tab["t_on"][i + 1])
        h = 2e-3
        c = self.stance_channels(side, np.full(3, i), np.array([t0, t0 - h, t0 - 2 * h]))
        c0 = c[0]
        v0 = (3 * c[0] - 4 * c[1] + c[2]) / (2 * h)       # stance-side velocity at toe-off
        c1 = self.stance_channels(side, [i + 1], [t1])[0]
        travel = float(np.linalg.norm(tab["c_flat"][i + 1] - tab["c_flat"][i]))
        sc = float(np.clip(travel / p["stride"], 0.0, 1.2))
        v1 = self.approach_velocity(side, i + 1, t1, c1, p["v_app"] * min(1.0, np.sqrt(sc / 0.8)))
        D = t1 - t0
        knots = {}
        f0, f1 = -c0[0], -c1[0]
        fpk = f1 + p["hip_retract"] * min(1.0, sc)
        knots[0] = ([0.0, 0.35, 0.80, 1.0], [-f0, -(f0 + 0.68 * (fpk - f0)), -fpk, -f1])
        k0, k1 = c0[3], c1[3]
        kpk = p["knee_pk_min"] + (p["knee_pk"] - p["knee_pk_min"]) * min(1.0, sc) ** 0.6
        kpk = max(kpk, k0 + 5.0 * DEG)
        k66 = max(0.574 * kpk, k1 + 6.0 * DEG)
        knots[3] = ([0.0, p["knee_pk_s"], 0.50, 0.66, 0.86, 1.0],
                    [k0, kpk, max(0.9 * kpk, k66 + 2 * DEG), k66, k1 + 3.0 * DEG, k1])
        d0, d1 = -c0[4], -c1[4]
        knots[4] = ([0.0, 0.12, 0.40, 0.72, 1.0],
                    [-d0, -(d0 - 5.0 * DEG * min(1.0, sc + 0.3)), -4.0 * DEG, -(d1 + 3.0 * DEG), -d1])
        e0, e1 = -c0[7], -c1[7]
        knots[7] = ([0.0, 0.25, 0.50, 1.0], [-e0, -0.5 * e0, -2.0 * DEG, -e1])
        for ch in (1, 2, 5, 6):     # large re-orientations (corners) mostly in mid-swing
            dc = c1[ch] - c0[ch]
            if abs(dc) > 10.0 * DEG:
                knots[ch] = ([0.0, 0.25, 0.75, 1.0],
                             [c0[ch], c0[ch] + 0.15 * dc, c0[ch] + 0.85 * dc, c1[ch]])
        spl = []
        for ch in range(8):
            S, V = knots.get(ch, ([0.0, 1.0], [c0[ch], c1[ch]]))
            spl.append(CubicSpline(S, V, bc_type=((1, v0[ch] * D), (1, v1[ch] * D))))
        out = [t0, D, spl, []]
        self._swing_cache[key] = out
        self._clear_swing(side, out)
        return out

    def swing_channels(self, side, i, t):
        t0, D, spl, extra = self.swing_splines(side, i)
        return self._channels(side, spl, extra, (np.asarray(t, dtype=float) - t0) / D)

    def _channels(self, side, spl, extra, s):
        c = np.stack([f(s) for f in spl], -1)
        sign = self.legs[side].sign
        c[:, 1] += sign * self.p["hip_ab_swing"] * bump(s, 3.0, 3.0)
        for kind, s_pk, amt in extra:    # guard corrections (see _clear_swing)
            w = np.exp(-((s - s_pk) / 0.22) ** 2) * bump(s, 2.0, 2.0) / bump(np.array(s_pk), 2.0, 2.0)
            if kind == "lift":           # more knee and hip flexion
                c[:, 3] += amt * w
                c[:, 0] -= 0.6 * amt * w
            else:                        # more hip abduction (foot further out)
                c[:, 1] += sign * amt * w
        return c

    def foot_frames(self, side, t, ch):
        """World ankle rotation and position for leg channels ch (n, 8) at times t."""
        leg = self.legs[side]
        P0, W0 = self.pelvis(t)
        Wh = W0 @ from_euler_xzy(ch[:, 0:3])
        Ph = P0 + mv(W0, leg.hip_off)
        Wk = Wh @ rx(ch[:, 3])
        Pk = Ph + mv(Wh, leg.a)
        return Wk @ from_euler_xzy(ch[:, 4:7]), Pk + mv(Wk, leg.b)

    def sole_height(self, side, t, ch):
        """Lowest of a few sole points (heel, sole edges, and the toe tip on the toe segment)
        above the floor for leg channels ch (n, 8) at times t."""
        leg = self.legs[side]
        Wa, Pa = self.foot_frames(side, t, ch)
        pts = sole_points(side)[:4] - J[leg.ankle]
        y = Pa[:, None, 1] + np.einsum("nj,kj->nk", Wa[:, 1, :], pts)
        Wt = Wa @ rx(ch[:, 7])
        tip = sole_points(side)[4] - J[leg.toe]
        y_toe = Pa[:, 1] + Wa[:, 1, :] @ (J[leg.toe] - J[leg.ankle]) + Wt[:, 1, :] @ tip
        return np.minimum(y.min(1), y_toe) - FLOOR

    def _other_foot_outline(self, side, tm):
        """Floor outline (k, 2) of the other foot if it is planted at time tm, else None."""
        other = "R" if side == "L" else "L"
        io, on = self.lookup(other, [tm])
        if not on[0]:
            return None
        Fo, ao, _ = self.stance_foot_pose(other, int(io[0]), [tm])
        return (ao[0] + mv(Fo[0], foot_outline(other) - J[self.legs[other].ankle]))[:, [0, 2]]

    def _clear_swing(self, side, sw, gap=0.035):
        """Guards for a walking swing, as a person lifts the foot a little more or swings it a
        little wider when needed:
          * toe clearance: if the swinging foot would pass closer to the floor than swing_clear
            in mid-swing (where it passes the standing leg), add a smooth bump of knee and hip
            flexion where it is lowest;
          * foot clearance: if it would pass closer than gap to the planted foot (tight turns),
            add a smooth bump of hip abduction there."""
        t0, D, spl, extra = sw
        s = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 61)
        tt = t0 + s * D
        # clearance wanted: none at lift-off and touch-down, swing_clear where the foot passes
        # the standing leg
        want = self.p["swing_clear"] * np.clip(np.minimum((s - 0.04) / 0.21, (0.92 - s) / 0.07), 0.0, 1.0)
        mid = (s > 0.04) & (s < 0.92)
        po = self._other_foot_outline(side, t0 + 0.5 * D)
        pts = foot_outline(side) - J[self.legs[side].ankle]
        for _ in range(5):
            ch = self._channels(side, spl, extra, s)
            h = self.sole_height(side, tt, ch)
            deficit = np.where(mid, want - h, -1.0)
            i = int(np.argmax(deficit))
            lift = sum(e[2] for e in extra if e[0] == "lift")
            done = True
            if deficit[i] >= 0.001 and lift < 10.0 * DEG:
                extra.append(("lift", float(s[i]), float(deficit[i] / 0.22 + 1.0 * DEG)))
                done = False
            if po is not None:
                Wa, Pa = self.foot_frames(side, tt, ch)
                pw = (Pa[:, None, :] + np.einsum("nij,kj->nki", Wa, pts))[:, :, [0, 2]]
                d = np.linalg.norm(pw[:, :, None, :] - po[None, None, :, :], axis=-1).min(axis=(1, 2))
                short = np.where((s > 0.1) & (s < 0.9), gap - d, -1.0)
                i = int(np.argmax(short))
                wide = sum(e[2] for e in extra if e[0] == "abd")
                if short[i] >= 0.002 and wide < 8.0 * DEG:
                    extra.append(("abd", float(np.clip(s[i], 0.25, 0.75)), float(short[i] / 0.8 + 0.5 * DEG)))
                    done = False
            if done:
                break

    # ================================================================== stepping swing
    def shuffle_path(self, side, i):
        """Foot path of a small step from plant i to plant i+1: the ankle moves on a cubic
        Hermite curve that leaves and arrives with the stance foot's own velocity, the foot
        turns smoothly to its new heading, and the path is lifted so that the lowest point of
        the sole clears the floor by turn_lift in mid-swing (and never touches it)."""
        key = ("shuffle", side, i)
        if key in self._swing_cache:
            return self._swing_cache[key]
        p = self.p
        leg = self.legs[side]
        tab = self.tab[side]
        t0, t1 = float(tab["t_off"][i]), float(tab["t_on"][i + 1])
        D = t1 - t0
        h = 2e-3
        F0, a0, toe0 = self.stance_foot_pose(side, i, [t0, t0 - h])
        F1, a1, toe1 = self.stance_foot_pose(side, i + 1, [t1, t1 + h])
        y0 = yaw_of(F0[0])
        y1 = y0 + wrap(yaw_of(F1[0]) - y0)
        pd0, pd1 = foot_pitch(F0), foot_pitch(F1)
        s = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 81)
        yaw = y0 + (y1 - y0) * smootherstep(s)
        pit = hermite(s, pd0[0], (pd0[0] - pd0[1]) / h * D, pd1[0], (pd1[1] - pd1[0]) / h * D)
        ank = hermite(s, a0[0], (a0[0] - a0[1]) / h * D, a1[0], (a1[1] - a1[0]) / h * D)
        F = ry(yaw) @ rx(pit)
        pts = sole_points(side) - J[leg.ankle]
        world = ank[:, None, :] + np.einsum("nij,kj->nki", F, pts)
        minh = world[:, :, 1].min(1) - FLOOR
        clr = p["turn_lift"] * bump(s, 2.0, 2.0)
        lift = np.maximum(clr - minh, 0.0)
        lift = np.maximum(gaussian_filter1d(lift, 3.0, mode="nearest"), lift)
        lift *= smoothstep(s / 0.06) * smoothstep((1.0 - s) / 0.06)
        ank = ank.copy()
        ank[:, 1] += lift
        ank = self._clear_other_foot(side, t0, D, s, F, ank)
        toe = toe0[0] * (1.0 - smoothstep(s / 0.4)) + toe1[0] * smoothstep((s - 0.6) / 0.4)
        out = (t0, D, s, yaw, pit, ank, toe)
        self._swing_cache[key] = out
        return out

    def _clear_other_foot(self, side, t0, D, s, F, ank, gap=0.04):
        """Push the path of a small step sideways, away from the planted foot, wherever the two
        sole outlines would come closer than gap (horizontally)."""
        po = self._other_foot_outline(side, t0 + 0.5 * D)
        if po is None:
            return ank
        pts = foot_outline(side) - J[self.legs[side].ankle]
        env = bump(s, 2.0, 2.0)
        for _ in range(3):
            pw = (ank[:, None, :] + np.einsum("nij,kj->nki", F, pts))[:, :, [0, 2]]
            d = np.linalg.norm(pw[:, :, None, :] - po[None, None, :, :], axis=-1).min(axis=(1, 2))
            need = gaussian_filter1d(np.maximum(gap - d, 0.0), 3.0, mode="nearest") * env
            if need.max() < 0.002:
                break
            away = pw.mean(1) - po.mean(0)
            away /= np.linalg.norm(away, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            ank = ank.copy()
            ank[:, 0] += 1.3 * need * away[:, 0]
            ank[:, 2] += 1.3 * need * away[:, 1]
        return ank

    def shuffle_foot(self, side, i, t):
        t0, D, s, yaw, pit, ank, toe = self.shuffle_path(side, i)
        u = np.clip((np.asarray(t, dtype=float) - t0) / D, 0.0, 1.0)
        F = ry(np.interp(u, s, yaw)) @ rx(np.interp(u, s, pit))
        A = np.stack([np.interp(u, s, ank[:, k]) for k in range(3)], -1)
        return F, A, np.interp(u, s, toe)

    # ================================================================== whole clip
    def pose_rotations(self, t):
        """Pelvis position (n, 3) and local rotations R (n, 22, 3, 3) at times t."""
        t = np.asarray(t, dtype=float)
        n = len(t)
        P0, W0 = self.pelvis(t)
        R = np.tile(np.eye(3), (n, NJ, 1, 1))
        R[:, 0] = W0
        self.diag = {}
        for side, leg in self.legs.items():
            idx, contact = self.lookup(side, t)
            i = np.nonzero(contact)[0]
            if len(i):
                Rh, th, Ra, toe, q = self.stance_pose(side, idx[i], t[i])
                R[i, leg.hip], R[i, leg.knee], R[i, leg.ankle], R[i, leg.toe] = Rh, rx(th), Ra, rx(toe)
                self.diag[side + "_q"] = q
            sw = np.nonzero(~contact)[0]
            for k in np.unique(idx[sw]):
                i = sw[idx[sw] == k]
                kind = self.plan.plants[side][k + 1].step.kind
                if kind == "walk":
                    c = self.swing_channels(side, int(k), t[i])
                    R[i, leg.hip] = from_euler_xzy(c[:, 0:3])
                    R[i, leg.knee] = rx(c[:, 3])
                    R[i, leg.ankle] = from_euler_xzy(c[:, 4:7])
                    R[i, leg.toe] = rx(c[:, 7])
                else:
                    F, A, toe = self.shuffle_foot(side, int(k), t[i])
                    Rh, th, Ra, _ = leg.ik(P0[i], W0[i], F, A)
                    R[i, leg.hip], R[i, leg.knee], R[i, leg.ankle], R[i, leg.toe] = Rh, rx(th), Ra, rx(toe)
        for j, M in upper_body(self, t, W0).items():
            R[:, j] = M
        return P0, R

    def generate(self, n_frames, fps):
        t = np.arange(n_frames) / float(fps)
        P0, R = self.pose_rotations(t)
        return dict(fps=int(fps), transl=P0 - J[0], global_orient=to_rotvec(R[:, 0]),
                    body_pose=to_rotvec(R[:, 1:]))


def calibrate(params=None):
    """Pelvis offset c_walk and static pelvic obliquity roll0 for steady straight walking.

    The SMPL-X skeleton is slightly asymmetric, and where the pelvis sits relative to the feet
    follows from the balance model; with the wrong values the required pelvis height would
    jump when the leading leg changes.  Newton iteration on (c_walk, roll0) makes both
    hand-overs continuous."""
    from .path import WalkLine
    from .plan import PlanBuilder
    q = make_params(params)
    q.update(var=0.0, c_walk=0.0, roll0=0.0)
    line = WalkLine([0.0, 0.0], 0.0, [{"type": "straight", "length": 40.0}])
    b = PlanBuilder(q)
    b.stand([0.0, 0.0], 0.0)
    b.wait(0.5)
    b.walk(line, stop=False, t_end=8.0, first="R")
    plan = b.finish(8.0)
    body = Body(plan, (0.0, 8.0), solve_height=False)
    st = plan.steps
    j = next(k for k, s in enumerate(st) if s.t_hs > 5.0)
    A, B, C = st[j - 1], st[j], st[j + 1]      # three consecutive touch-downs
    eps = 1e-6

    def yr(step, t):
        idx = step.plant_index
        u, lam = body.u_lam(step.side, [idx], [t])
        return body.y_required(step.side, [idx], [t], u, lam)[0]

    def mismatch(x):
        q["c_walk"], q["roll0"] = float(x[0]), float(x[1])
        return np.array([yr(A, B.t_hs - eps) - yr(B, B.t_hs), yr(B, C.t_hs - eps) - yr(C, C.t_hs)])

    x = np.array([0.0, 0.0])
    for _ in range(15):
        m = mismatch(x)
        if np.max(np.abs(m)) < 1e-7:
            break
        Jm = np.zeros((2, 2))
        for i in range(2):
            dx = np.zeros(2)
            dx[i] = 1e-4
            Jm[:, i] = (mismatch(x + dx) - m) / 1e-4
        x = x - np.linalg.solve(Jm, m)
    return float(x[0]), float(x[1])

1	"""Spine, head and arms, for a whole clip at once.
2	
3	Thorax and head orientations are specified in the world (heading, lean, small oscillations)
4	and distributed over the spine and neck joints, so the head stays steady while the pelvis
5	rotates and tilts underneath it.
6	
7	Heading order.  People turn the eyes and head first, then the trunk, then the pelvis and
8	feet.  The thorax faces where the pelvis heading program will point thorax_lead_t seconds
9	later, and the head turns towards where it will point gaze_lead_t seconds later (taking
10	head_gain of that direction; the eyes do the rest).  This works the same way for a bend in
11	the path, a corner and a turn on the spot.
12	
13	All gait oscillations (thorax counter-rotation, arm swing, head bob) are scaled by the step
14	size envelope g, so they grow over the first steps of a walk and die away when stopping.

"""Spine, head and arms, for a whole clip at once.

Thorax and head orientations are specified in the world (heading, lean, small oscillations)
and distributed over the spine and neck joints, so the head stays steady while the pelvis
rotates and tilts underneath it.

Heading order.  People turn the eyes and head first, then the trunk, then the pelvis and
feet.  The thorax faces where the pelvis heading program will point thorax_lead_t seconds
later, and the head turns towards where it will point gaze_lead_t seconds later (taking
head_gain of that direction; the eyes do the rest).  This works the same way for a bend in
the path, a corner and a turn on the spot.

All gait oscillations (thorax counter-rotation, arm swing, head bob) are scaled by the step
size envelope g, so they grow over the first steps of a walk and die away when stopping.
When standing there is a slow breathing movement of the chest and a slight drift of the head.
"""
import numpy as np

from .rotations import (DEG, axis_angle, from_rotvec, mv, rot_between, rx, ry, rz, to_rotvec,
                        tr, wrap)
from .skeleton import IDX, J

# rest direction of each arm (shoulder -> wrist), the axis of the visible arm
ARM_REST = {}
for _s in ("left", "right"):
    _v = J[IDX[_s + "_wrist"]] - J[IDX[_s + "_shoulder"]]
    ARM_REST[_s] = _v / np.linalg.norm(_v)


def upper_body(body, t, W0):
    """Local rotations {joint index: (n, 3, 3)} of spine, neck, head, collars, arms, wrists."""
    p = body.p
    t = np.asarray(t, dtype=float)
    ph, g, e = body.envelopes(t)
    gc = np.minimum(g, 1.0)
    v = p["var"]
    n = len(t)
    out = {}
    lean_lat, lean_fwd = body.lean(t)

    # thorax (world): faces slightly ahead of the pelvis heading, counter-rotates against the
    # pelvis, leans forward a little (more when walking, and while speeding up), leans into
    # bends, small lateral lean toward the stance leg; breathing when standing
    t_yaw = 3.2 * DEG * g * np.cos(2 * np.pi * (ph - 0.04))
    breath = (1.0 - gc) * 0.5 * DEG * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 4.3 + 0.3)
    t_pitch = ((1.5 + 2.5 * gc) * DEG + 0.8 * DEG * g * np.cos(4 * np.pi * (ph - 0.12))
               + 0.4 * np.maximum(lean_fwd, 0.0) + breath)
    t_roll = -1.2 * DEG * e * (0.3 + 0.7 * gc) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ph)
    h_tx = body.psi(t + p["thorax_lead_t"])
    Wt = ry(h_tx + t_yaw) @ rx(t_pitch) @ rz(t_roll - p["thorax_lean"] * lean_lat)
    rv = to_rotvec(tr(W0) @ Wt)
    for name, f in zip(("spine1", "spine2", "spine3"), (0.30, 0.35, 0.35)):
        out[IDX[name]] = from_rotvec(rv * f)

    # head: turns toward where the body is about to face, stabilised in space, slow drift
    gaze = body.psi(t + p["gaze_lead_t"])
    h_yaw = (h_tx + p["head_gain"] * wrap(gaze - h_tx) + 0.25 * t_yaw
             + v * 1.5 * DEG * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 5.3 + 0.4))
    h_pitch = ((4.0 + 3.0 * gc) * DEG - 0.6 * DEG * g * np.cos(4 * np.pi * (ph - 0.30))
               + v * 1.0 * DEG * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 3.7 + 1.3))
    h_roll = 0.3 * t_roll - p["head_lean"] * lean_lat
    Wh = ry(h_yaw) @ rx(h_pitch) @ rz(h_roll)
    rvh = to_rotvec(tr(Wt) @ Wh)
    out[IDX["neck"]] = from_rotvec(rvh * 0.55)
    out[IDX["head"]] = from_rotvec(rvh * 0.45)

    # arms.  The visible arm is the shoulder->wrist line of the rest mesh (the elbow joints of
    # this skeleton sit off that line, differently on the two sides), so the shoulder rotation
    # aligns that rest vector with the wanted hang direction.  In a bend the effective gravity
    # (gravity plus centrifugal) tilts with the body lean, so the arms keep hanging the same way
    # relative to the thorax.
    down = np.array([0.0, -1.0, 0.0])
    for side, sign, off in (("left", 1.0, 0.0), ("right", -1.0, 0.5)):
        phs = ph - off
        amp_var = 1.0 + v * 0.06 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 4.7 + (0.9 if sign > 0 else 2.6))
        fwd = np.cos(2 * np.pi * (phs - 0.55))           # +1 = arm most forward
        fwd2 = np.cos(4 * np.pi * (phs - 0.55))
        swing = (16.0 * DEG * fwd + 2.0 * DEG * fwd2) * amp_var * g
        # shoulder flexion (+ forward) in the thorax frame; arms hang with gravity, so add the
        # thorax forward lean; mean slightly behind the body line when walking
        flex = -(1.0 + 5.0 * gc) * DEG + swing + t_pitch
        # a bit wider when behind; the right shoulder joint of this skeleton sits 1.2 cm closer
        # to the midline, so that arm gets 1.2 deg more to mirror the left one
        abd = (9.0 + 2.0 * gc + (1.2 if sign < 0 else 0.0)) * DEG - 1.5 * DEG * g * fwd
        col = rz(np.full(n, -sign * 5.0 * DEG)) @ ry(-sign * 3.0 * DEG * g * fwd)   # drop + protract
        out[IDX[side + "_collar"]] = col
        d = mv(rx(-flex) @ rz(sign * abd), down)                                     # wanted arm axis
        base = rz(-sign * 90.0 * DEG)                    # T-pose -> arm down, palm medial
        Q = rot_between(np.broadcast_to(base @ ARM_REST[side], (n, 3)), d) @ base
        Q = axis_angle(d, np.full(n, sign * 14.0 * DEG)) @ Q    # humeral internal rotation
        out[IDX[side + "_shoulder"]] = tr(col) @ Q
        # elbow: relaxed bend; when walking, flexion peaks just after the most forward position
        fwd_e = np.cos(2 * np.pi * (phs - 0.60))
        el = ((12.0 + 10.0 * gc) * DEG + 12.0 * DEG * g * fwd_e) * (0.5 + 0.5 * amp_var)
        out[IDX[side + "_elbow"]] = ry(-sign * el)
        # wrist: slight flexion with a passive lag
        wr = 7.0 * DEG + 4.0 * DEG * g * np.cos(2 * np.pi * (phs - 0.72))
        out[IDX[side + "_wrist"]] = rz(-sign * wr) @ ry(np.full(n, -sign * 3.0 * DEG))
    return out

1	"""Gait parameters and the normal-gait target curves.
2	
3	Stance phase u.  Every period a foot spends on the floor ("plant") has its own stance clock
4	u(t), which drives the foot rockers, the target knee angle and the centre of pressure.  In
5	steady walking u runs exactly as in a normal gait cycle (0 = heel strike, 0.1 = the other
6	foot leaves the floor, 0.5 = the other foot lands, 0.6 = toe off).  A standing foot rests at
7	u = U_ST (flat foot).  See plan.py for how u(t) is built for starts, stops and turns.
8	"""
9	import numpy as np
10	from scipy.interpolate import PchipInterpolator
11	
12	from .rotations import DEG
13	
14	# Normal adult sagittal curves (degrees), written from general biomechanics knowledge.
15	# Stance-knee flexion of the leading leg (heel strike -> opposite heel strike), used to solve
16	# the pelvis height.
17	KNEE_TGT = PchipInterpolator(
18	    [0.00, 0.03, 0.06, 0.10, 0.14, 0.18, 0.22, 0.27, 0.32, 0.37, 0.41, 0.45, 0.50, 0.55],
19	    [5.0, 8.5, 12.0, 15.5, 17.5, 16.8, 14.5, 11.0, 8.0, 6.0, 5.0, 6.0, 10.0, 18.0])
20	# Minimum knee flexion of a stance leg: near zero until terminal stance, then the knee must
21	# bend quickly in pre-swing (the heel rises further if needed to allow it).
22	KNEE_FLOOR = PchipInterpolator(
23	    [0.00, 0.45, 0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.62, 0.70],
24	    [1.5, 1.5, 7.5, 17.5, 31.0, 35.0, 48.0])
25	# Centre of pressure under a foot: distance ahead of the heel-circle centre [m] along the
26	# foot.  It starts under the heel, crosses the mid-foot, and ends under the toes at toe off.
27	COP_FWD = PchipInterpolator([0.0, 0.08, 0.20, 0.31, 0.50, 0.60],
28	                            [-0.010, 0.035, 0.092, 0.120, 0.165, 0.200])
29	
30	U_ST = 0.20        # stance phase of a standing foot (flat foot, centre of pressure mid-foot)
31	GRAVITY = 9.81
32	
33	DEFAULTS = dict(
34	    # --- steady gait (straight line)
35	    T=1.06,              # gait cycle on a straight line [s]  (~113 steps / min)
36	    stride=1.30,         # stride length on a straight line [m] -> 1.23 m/s
37	    heel_x=0.068,        # lateral position of the heel-circle centres (+-) when walking [m]
38	    toe_out=4.5 * DEG,   # foot progression angle when walking
39	    ds_frac=0.20,        # double support as a fraction of the step period
40	    knee_geo=0.75,       # share of the skeleton's knee asymmetry absorbed by the knees
41	    v_app=0.30,          # forward heel speed over the floor just before contact [m/s]
42	    alpha_hs=19.0 * DEG,  # foot pitch (toes up) at heel strike
43	    toe_hs=8.0 * DEG,    # toe extension at heel strike
44	    phi_ff=0.08,         # foot flat
45	    phi_to=0.60,         # toe off
46	    soft_w=1.0 * DEG,    # softness of the soft maximum in the heel-rise angle
47	    heel_rise_max=70.0 * DEG,  # largest foot pitch over the ball of the foot
48	    pivot_gain=0.75,     # in late stance a foot pivots on the ball of the foot towards the
49	    pivot_free=8.0 * DEG,  # ... body's heading by this share of the misalignment beyond pivot_free
50	    pivot_max=30.0 * DEG,  # ... but at most this much (turns and corners)
51	    u_hr=0.31,           # heel off
52	    alpha_50=14.0 * DEG,  # heel-rise angle at opposite heel strike
53	    hr_pow=1.7,          # shape of the heel-rise profile
54	    u_tr=0.50,           # toes start to roll (toe rocker)
55	    beta_to=22.0 * DEG,  # toe segment pitch at toe off
56	    yaw_amp=4.5 * DEG,   # pelvis rotation
57	    roll_amp=3.5 * DEG,  # pelvic drop
58	    pitch_mean=3.0 * DEG,  # forward pelvic tilt when walking
59	    pitch_stand=1.0 * DEG,  # ... and when standing
60	    pitch_amp=1.0 * DEG,
61	    knee_pk=61.0 * DEG,  # peak swing knee flexion (full-length step)
62	    knee_pk_min=30.0 * DEG,  # ... for a step of almost no length
63	    knee_pk_s=0.30,      # ... at this fraction of the swing
64	    swing_clear=0.014,   # lowest sole point of a walking swing at least this high mid-swing [m]
65	    hip_retract=4.0 * DEG,  # hip flexion peak above its heel-strike value
66	    hip_ab_swing=1.5 * DEG,  # slight abduction of the swing leg (clearance)
67	    var=1.0,             # scale of the slow natural variations (0 = perfectly periodic)
68	    c_walk=None,         # pelvis ahead of the centre of mass when walking (calibrated if None)
69	    roll0=None,          # static pelvic obliquity absorbing skeleton asymmetry (calibrated if None)
70	    # --- pelvis height fit
71	    y_rate=120.0,        # samples per second of the required-height curve
72	    y_lambda=1500.0,     # smoothness weight (third differences)

74	    # --- balance (inverted pendulum)
75	    com_height=0.95,     # height of the centre of mass [m]
76	    lean_sigma=0.22,     # smoothing of the centre-of-mass acceleration that drives the lean [s]
77	    # --- walking a curved line

85	    corner_min=40.0 * DEG,  # ... (if it turns at least this much) with the outer foot at its apex
86	    turn_slow=0.16,      # speed factor 1 / (1 + turn_slow * k + turn_slow2 * k^2), k = |curvature| * 1 m
87	    turn_slow2=0.12,     # ... (the quadratic term slows tight turns down much more)
88	    slow_sigma=0.4,      # ... curvature smoothed over this length [m]
89	    slow_lead=0.4,       # ... and looked up this far ahead (people slow before a bend) [m]
90	    slow_lag=0.2,        # ... and this far behind (and speed up again only after it) [m]
91	    cad_share=0.4,       # share of the slow-down taken by cadence (rest by step length)
92	    lean_gain=0.85,      # fraction of the physical lean angle atan(v^2 k / g)
93	    lean_max=7.0 * DEG,  # ... but never more than this
94	    shift_max=0.055,     # largest outward shift of the feet in a bend [m] (< heel_x)
95	    shift_lead=0.15,     # feet are shifted outwards for the lean found this far ahead [m]
96	    foot_yaw_lead=0.12,  # a planted foot points along the line this far beyond it [m]
97	    pelvis_lean=0.5,     # share of the lean shown as pelvis roll
98	    thorax_lean=1.0,     # share of the lean shown by the thorax (in world)
99	    head_lean=0.6,       # share of the lean shown by the head (righting reflex keeps it upright)
100	    # --- standing
101	    stand_half_width=0.085,  # heel-circle centres +- this far from the midline [m]
102	    stand_toe_out=7.0 * DEG,
103	    knee_stand=4.0 * DEG,    # knee flexion when standing
104	    stand_sway=1.0,          # scale of the slow postural sway
105	    # --- starting and stopping
106	    start_wait=0.80,     # standing time before the weight shift of the first step [s]
107	    unload=0.30,        # a standing foot is unloaded over this time before it lifts [s]
108	    first_swing=0.40,    # swing time of the first step from standing [s]
109	    start_len=(0.60, 0.85, 0.97),   # step lengths of the first steps (x the normal step)
110	    start_time=(1.0, 1.04, 1.02),   # step periods of the first steps (x the normal period)
111	    stop_len=(0.70, 0.90),          # last steps before the closing step, last first
112	    stop_time=(1.06, 1.02),
113	    close_ds=0.13,       # double support before the closing step of a stop [s]
114	    close_swing=0.48,    # swing time of the closing step [s]
115	    close_alpha=5.0 * DEG,  # foot pitch when the closing foot touches down
116	    # --- turning on the spot
117	    turn_max_step=65.0 * DEG,  # largest rotation of a foot in one step
118	    turn_half_width=0.11,      # feet a little wider apart while turning [m]
119	    turn_swing=0.33,           # swing time of a turning step [s]
120	    turn_ds=0.10,              # double support between turning steps [s]
121	    turn_alpha=3.0 * DEG,      # foot pitch at touch-down
122	    turn_lift=0.045,           # lowest sole point this high in mid-swing [m]
123	    turn_pause=0.15,           # standing time between stopping and starting the turn [s]
124	    # --- upper body
125	    thorax_lead_t=0.20,  # the thorax faces where the pelvis will face this much later [s]
126	    gaze_lead_t=0.55,    # the gaze is directed where the body will face this much later [s]
127	    head_gain=0.75,      # share of the gaze direction (relative to the thorax) taken by the head
128	)
129	
130	
131	def make_params(overrides=None):
132	    p = dict(DEFAULTS)
133	    if overrides:
134	        unknown = set(overrides) - set(p)
135	        if unknown:
136	            raise KeyError("unknown gait parameters: %s" % sorted(unknown))
137	        p.update(overrides)
138	    return p
139	
140	
141	def heel_profile(u, p, push=1.0):
142	    """Prescribed heel rise (foot pitch about the ball of the foot) from heel-off on."""
143	    s = (u - p["u_hr"]) / (0.5 - p["u_hr"])
144	    return push * p["alpha_50"] * np.maximum(s, 0.0) ** p["hr_pow"]
145	
146	
147	def toe_beta(u, p, push=1.0):
148	    """Pitch of the toe segment rolling over the toe pad (toe rocker)."""
149	    s = (u - p["u_tr"]) / (p["phi_to"] - p["u_tr"])
150	    return push * p["beta_to"] * np.maximum(s, 0.0) ** 2
151	
152	
153	def knee_floor(u, push=1.0):
154	    """Minimum stance knee flexion [deg]; a smaller push-off needs less pre-swing flexion."""
155	    return 1.5 + push * (KNEE_FLOOR(u) - 1.5)
156	
157	
158	def knee_target(u, lam, p):
159	    """Target knee flexion [deg] of a weight-bearing leg: the normal loading response scaled
160	    by lam (1 = walking heel strike, 0 = standing)."""
161	    ks = p["knee_stand"] / DEG
162	    return ks + lam * (KNEE_TGT(u) - ks)
163	
164	
165	def bend_speed_factor(k, p):
166	    """Speed factor in a bend of curvature k [1/m]."""
167	    k = np.abs(k)
168	    return 1.0 / (1.0 + p["turn_slow"] * k + p["turn_slow2"] * k ** 2)

"""Gait parameters and the normal-gait target curves.

Stance phase u.  Every period a foot spends on the floor ("plant") has its own stance clock
u(t), which drives the foot rockers, the target knee angle and the centre of pressure.  In
steady walking u runs exactly as in a normal gait cycle (0 = heel strike, 0.1 = the other
foot leaves the floor, 0.5 = the other foot lands, 0.6 = toe off).  A standing foot rests at
u = U_ST (flat foot).  See plan.py for how u(t) is built for starts, stops and turns.
"""
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import PchipInterpolator

from .rotations import DEG

# Normal adult sagittal curves (degrees), written from general biomechanics knowledge.
# Stance-knee flexion of the leading leg (heel strike -> opposite heel strike), used to solve
# the pelvis height.
KNEE_TGT = PchipInterpolator(
    [0.00, 0.03, 0.06, 0.10, 0.14, 0.18, 0.22, 0.27, 0.32, 0.37, 0.41, 0.45, 0.50, 0.55],
    [5.0, 8.5, 12.0, 15.5, 17.5, 16.8, 14.5, 11.0, 8.0, 6.0, 5.0, 6.0, 10.0, 18.0])
# Minimum knee flexion of a stance leg: near zero until terminal stance, then the knee must
# bend quickly in pre-swing (the heel rises further if needed to allow it).
KNEE_FLOOR = PchipInterpolator(
    [0.00, 0.45, 0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.62, 0.70],
    [1.5, 1.5, 7.5, 17.5, 31.0, 35.0, 48.0])
# Centre of pressure under a foot: distance ahead of the heel-circle centre [m] along the
# foot.  It starts under the heel, crosses the mid-foot, and ends under the toes at toe off.
COP_FWD = PchipInterpolator([0.0, 0.08, 0.20, 0.31, 0.50, 0.60],
                            [-0.010, 0.035, 0.092, 0.120, 0.165, 0.200])

U_ST = 0.20        # stance phase of a standing foot (flat foot, centre of pressure mid-foot)
GRAVITY = 9.81

DEFAULTS = dict(
    # --- steady gait (straight line)
    T=1.06,              # gait cycle on a straight line [s]  (~113 steps / min)
    stride=1.30,         # stride length on a straight line [m] -> 1.23 m/s
    heel_x=0.068,        # lateral position of the heel-circle centres (+-) when walking [m]
    toe_out=4.5 * DEG,   # foot progression angle when walking
    ds_frac=0.20,        # double support as a fraction of the step period
    knee_geo=0.75,       # share of the skeleton's knee asymmetry absorbed by the knees
    v_app=0.30,          # forward heel speed over the floor just before contact [m/s]
    alpha_hs=19.0 * DEG,  # foot pitch (toes up) at heel strike
    toe_hs=8.0 * DEG,    # toe extension at heel strike
    phi_ff=0.08,         # foot flat
    phi_to=0.60,         # toe off
    soft_w=1.0 * DEG,    # softness of the soft maximum in the heel-rise angle
    heel_rise_max=70.0 * DEG,  # largest foot pitch over the ball of the foot
    pivot_gain=0.75,     # in late stance a foot pivots on the ball of the foot towards the
    pivot_free=8.0 * DEG,  # ... body's heading by this share of the misalignment beyond pivot_free
    pivot_max=30.0 * DEG,  # ... but at most this much (turns and corners)
    u_hr=0.31,           # heel off
    alpha_50=14.0 * DEG,  # heel-rise angle at opposite heel strike
    hr_pow=1.7,          # shape of the heel-rise profile
    u_tr=0.50,           # toes start to roll (toe rocker)
    beta_to=22.0 * DEG,  # toe segment pitch at toe off
    yaw_amp=4.5 * DEG,   # pelvis rotation
    roll_amp=3.5 * DEG,  # pelvic drop
    pitch_mean=3.0 * DEG,  # forward pelvic tilt when walking
    pitch_stand=1.0 * DEG,  # ... and when standing
    pitch_amp=1.0 * DEG,
    knee_pk=61.0 * DEG,  # peak swing knee flexion (full-length step)
    knee_pk_min=30.0 * DEG,  # ... for a step of almost no length
    knee_pk_s=0.30,      # ... at this fraction of the swing
    swing_clear=0.014,   # lowest sole point of a walking swing at least this high mid-swing [m]
    hip_retract=4.0 * DEG,  # hip flexion peak above its heel-strike value
    hip_ab_swing=1.5 * DEG,  # slight abduction of the swing leg (clearance)
    var=1.0,             # scale of the slow natural variations (0 = perfectly periodic)
    c_walk=None,         # pelvis ahead of the centre of mass when walking (calibrated if None)
    roll0=None,          # static pelvic obliquity absorbing skeleton asymmetry (calibrated if None)
    # --- pelvis height fit
    y_rate=120.0,        # samples per second of the required-height curve
    y_lambda=1500.0,     # smoothness weight (third differences)
    y_margin=0.0003,     # the fitted pelvis stays this far below the required height [m]
    # --- balance (inverted pendulum)
    com_height=0.95,     # height of the centre of mass [m]
    lean_sigma=0.22,     # smoothing of the centre-of-mass acceleration that drives the lean [s]
    # --- walking a curved line
    line_sigma=0.25,     # body line: smoothing of the marked path along its length [m]
    fillet_frac=0.35,    # ... polyline corners rounded to stay within this share of the tolerance
    feet_sigma=0.12,     # feet line (where the footprints go): much less smoothing ...
    feet_fillet_frac=0.1,  # ... and tighter corners
    apex_out=0.04,       # the outer foot at the apex of a corner is put this much further out [m]
    after_apex_len=0.8,  # length of the step after the apex (x the normal step)
    sharp_turn=0.7,      # a bend turning faster than this [rad/m, smoothed] is taken as a corner:
    corner_min=40.0 * DEG,  # ... (if it turns at least this much) with the outer foot at its apex
    turn_slow=0.16,      # speed factor 1 / (1 + turn_slow * k + turn_slow2 * k^2), k = |curvature| * 1 m
    turn_slow2=0.12,     # ... (the quadratic term slows tight turns down much more)
    slow_sigma=0.4,      # ... curvature smoothed over this length [m]
    slow_lead=0.4,       # ... and looked up this far ahead (people slow before a bend) [m]
    slow_lag=0.2,        # ... and this far behind (and speed up again only after it) [m]
    cad_share=0.4,       # share of the slow-down taken by cadence (rest by step length)
    lean_gain=0.85,      # fraction of the physical lean angle atan(v^2 k / g)
    lean_max=7.0 * DEG,  # ... but never more than this
    shift_max=0.055,     # largest outward shift of the feet in a bend [m] (< heel_x)
    shift_lead=0.15,     # feet are shifted outwards for the lean found this far ahead [m]
    foot_yaw_lead=0.12,  # a planted foot points along the line this far beyond it [m]
    pelvis_lean=0.5,     # share of the lean shown as pelvis roll
    thorax_lean=1.0,     # share of the lean shown by the thorax (in world)
    head_lean=0.6,       # share of the lean shown by the head (righting reflex keeps it upright)
    # --- standing
    stand_half_width=0.085,  # heel-circle centres +- this far from the midline [m]
    stand_toe_out=7.0 * DEG,
    knee_stand=4.0 * DEG,    # knee flexion when standing
    stand_sway=1.0,          # scale of the slow postural sway
    # --- starting and stopping
    start_wait=0.80,     # standing time before the weight shift of the first step [s]
    unload=0.30,        # a standing foot is unloaded over this time before it lifts [s]
    first_swing=0.40,    # swing time of the first step from standing [s]
    start_len=(0.60, 0.85, 0.97),   # step lengths of the first steps (x the normal step)
    start_time=(1.0, 1.04, 1.02),   # step periods of the first steps (x the normal period)
    stop_len=(0.70, 0.90),          # last steps before the closing step, last first
    stop_time=(1.06, 1.02),
    close_ds=0.13,       # double support before the closing step of a stop [s]
    close_swing=0.48,    # swing time of the closing step [s]
    close_alpha=5.0 * DEG,  # foot pitch when the closing foot touches down
    # --- turning on the spot
    turn_max_step=65.0 * DEG,  # largest rotation of a foot in one step
    turn_half_width=0.11,      # feet a little wider apart while turning [m]
    turn_swing=0.33,           # swing time of a turning step [s]
    turn_ds=0.10,              # double support between turning steps [s]
    turn_alpha=3.0 * DEG,      # foot pitch at touch-down
    turn_lift=0.045,           # lowest sole point this high in mid-swing [m]
    turn_pause=0.15,           # standing time between stopping and starting the turn [s]
    # --- upper body
    thorax_lead_t=0.20,  # the thorax faces where the pelvis will face this much later [s]
    gaze_lead_t=0.55,    # the gaze is directed where the body will face this much later [s]
    head_gain=0.75,      # share of the gaze direction (relative to the thorax) taken by the head
)


def make_params(overrides=None):
    p = dict(DEFAULTS)
    if overrides:
        unknown = set(overrides) - set(p)
        if unknown:
            raise KeyError("unknown gait parameters: %s" % sorted(unknown))
        p.update(overrides)
    return p


def heel_profile(u, p, push=1.0):
    """Prescribed heel rise (foot pitch about the ball of the foot) from heel-off on."""
    s = (u - p["u_hr"]) / (0.5 - p["u_hr"])
    return push * p["alpha_50"] * np.maximum(s, 0.0) ** p["hr_pow"]


def toe_beta(u, p, push=1.0):
    """Pitch of the toe segment rolling over the toe pad (toe rocker)."""
    s = (u - p["u_tr"]) / (p["phi_to"] - p["u_tr"])
    return push * p["beta_to"] * np.maximum(s, 0.0) ** 2


def knee_floor(u, push=1.0):
    """Minimum stance knee flexion [deg]; a smaller push-off needs less pre-swing flexion."""
    return 1.5 + push * (KNEE_FLOOR(u) - 1.5)


def knee_target(u, lam, p):
    """Target knee flexion [deg] of a weight-bearing leg: the normal loading response scaled
    by lam (1 = walking heel strike, 0 = standing)."""
    ks = p["knee_stand"] / DEG
    return ks + lam * (KNEE_TGT(u) - ks)


def bend_speed_factor(k, p):
    """Speed factor in a bend of curvature k [1/m]."""
    k = np.abs(k)
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + p["turn_slow"] * k + p["turn_slow2"] * k ** 2)

2

6	  of the flat foot, tip_flat (n,3) toe-pad pivot of the flat foot, alpha (n,) foot pitch at
7	  touch-down, push (n,) size of the push-off (heel rise, toe roll, pre-swing knee bend).
8	"""
9	import numpy as np
10	
11	from .gait import heel_profile, knee_floor, toe_beta
12	from .rotations import DEG, mtv, mv, rot_between, rx, ry, axis_angle, smoothstep, softplus, tr, wrap
13	from .skeleton import FLOOR, IDX, J, LM
14	
15	HEEL_R = 0.041   # radius of the rounded heel (fit to the heel_back / heel_bottom landmarks)
16	HEEL_Z = -0.080  # z of the heel-circle centre in the rest pose
17	PIVOT_BACK = 0.03  # forefoot pivot this far behind the toe-pad pivot [m]
18	
19	
20	class Leg:
21	    def __init__(self, side):
22	        self.side = side
23	        self.sign = 1.0 if side == "L" else -1.0
24	        pre = "left_" if side == "L" else "right_"
25	        self.hip, self.knee = IDX[pre + "hip"], IDX[pre + "knee"]
26	        self.ankle, self.toe = IDX[pre + "ankle"], IDX[pre + "foot"]
27	        self.a = J[self.knee] - J[self.hip]             # thigh bone
28	        self.b = J[self.ankle] - J[self.knee]           # shank bone
29	        self.hip_off = J[self.hip] - J[0]               # hip joint relative to the pelvis joint
30	        self.heel_c = np.array([LM[pre + "heel_bottom"][0], FLOOR + HEEL_R, HEEL_Z])
31	        self.tip = np.array([0.095 * self.sign, FLOOR, 0.127])   # toe-pad pivot (rest)
32	        self.r_ta = J[self.toe] - J[self.ankle]         # ankle -> ball of the foot
33	        a, b = self.a, self.b
34	        self._A = a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]
35	        self._B = a[2] * b[1] - a[1] * b[2]
36	        self._K = a @ a + b @ b + 2 * a[0] * b[0]
37	        self.straight_knee = np.arctan2(self._B, self._A)   # knee angle of a fully straight leg
38	
39	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- knee <-> hip-ankle distance
40	    def knee_from_distance(self, d):
41	        """Knee flexion theta (about x) with |a + Rx(theta) b| = d.  Returns (theta, q);
42	        q > 1 means the target is out of reach (the leg is then fully straight)."""
43	        rho = np.hypot(self._A, self._B)
44	        q = (0.5 * (d * d - self._K)) / rho
45	        return self.straight_knee + np.arccos(np.clip(q, -1.0, 1.0)), q
46	
47	    def distance_from_knee(self, th):
48	        return np.sqrt(self._K + 2 * (self._A * np.cos(th) + self._B * np.sin(th)))
49	
50	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- foot placement helpers
51	    def flat_foot(self, xz, Fy):
52	        """Heel-circle centre and toe pivot of a flat foot whose heel-circle centre is above
53	        floor point xz (n, 2) and whose yaw rotation is Fy (n, 3, 3)."""
54	        xz = np.atleast_2d(xz)
55	        c = np.stack([xz[:, 0], np.full(len(xz), FLOOR + HEEL_R), xz[:, 1]], -1)
56	        return c, c + mv(Fy, self.tip - self.heel_c)
57	
58	    def ankle_of(self, F, c_heel):
59	        """Ankle position of a foot with orientation F whose heel-circle centre is c_heel."""
60	        return c_heel - mv(F, self.heel_c - J[self.ankle])
61	
62	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- stance foot
63	    def stance_foot(self, tab, u, p, hip=None):
64	        """Foot orientation F, ankle position and toe angle at stance phase u.
65	
66	        u < phi_ff: heel rocker (the foot rolls down over the rounded heel).
67	        otherwise : the foot is flat, then pitches about the ball of the foot (heel rise) while
68	                    the toes stay on the floor; late in stance the toes roll over the toe pad.
69	        The heel-rise angle is a soft maximum of a prescribed heel-off profile and the rise
70	        needed for the knee to bend at least the pre-swing minimum (needs the hip positions;
71	        without them only the profile is used)."""
72	        u = np.asarray(u, dtype=float)
73	        n = len(u)
74	        F = np.empty((n, 3, 3))
75	        ank = np.empty((n, 3))
76	        toe = np.empty(n)
77	        e = u < p["phi_ff"]
78	        if e.any():
79	            s = u[e] / p["phi_ff"]
80	            # front-loaded: fastest plantarflexion right after contact, soft forefoot landing
81	            a_up = tab["alpha"][e] * (1.0 - s) ** 2
82	            Fe = tab["Fy"][e] @ rx(-a_up)
83	            c = tab["c_flat"][e] - HEEL_R * a_up[:, None] * tab["fwd"][e]
84	            ank[e] = c - mv(Fe, self.heel_c - J[self.ankle])
85	            F[e] = Fe
86	            toe[e] = -p["toe_hs"] * (tab["alpha"][e] / p["alpha_hs"]) * (1.0 - smoothstep(s))
87	        l = ~e
88	        if l.any():
89	            ul = u[l]
90	            Fy = tab["Fy"][l]
91	            tip = tab["tip_flat"][l]
92	            if "pivot" in tab:
93	                # pivot on the forefoot (about the vertical through the middle of the forefoot
94	                # contact) while the heel is up, towards where the body is going
95	                Rp = ry(tab["pivot"][l] * smoothstep((ul - 0.25) / 0.33))
96	                q = tip - PIVOT_BACK * tab["fwd"][l]
97	                tip = q + mv(Rp, tip - q)
98	                Fy = Rp @ Fy
99	            push = tab["push"][l]
100	            beta = toe_beta(ul, p, push)
101	            m = tip + mv(Fy @ rx(beta), J[self.toe] - self.tip)
102	            al = heel_profile(ul, p, push)
103	            if hip is not None:
104	                al = self._soft_heel(al, hip[l], m, Fy, ul, p, push)
105	            Fl = Fy @ rx(al)
106	            ank[l] = m - mv(Fl, self.r_ta)
107	            F[l] = Fl
108	            toe[l] = beta - al
109	        return F, ank, toe
110	
111	    def _soft_heel(self, a_prof, hip, m, Fy, u, p, push):
112	        """Soft maximum of the heel-off profile and the heel rise that lets the knee bend
113	        knee_floor(u).  The hip-ankle distance squared is K + A cos(al) + B sin(al) in the
114	        heel-rise angle al, so the needed rise has a closed form."""
115	        q = mtv(Fy, hip - m)
116	        r = self.r_ta
117	        K = np.sum(q * q, -1) + r @ r + 2 * q[:, 0] * r[0]
118	        A = 2 * (q[:, 1] * r[1] + q[:, 2] * r[2])
119	        B = 2 * (q[:, 2] * r[1] - q[:, 1] * r[2])
120	        rho = np.hypot(A, B)
121	        psi = np.arctan2(B, A)
122	        d = self.distance_from_knee(knee_floor(u, push) * DEG)
123	        c = (d * d - K) / rho
124	        a_fl = wrap(psi + np.arccos(np.clip(c, -1.0, 1.0)))   # crossing on the decreasing branch
125	        w = p["soft_w"]
126	        a_fl = np.where(c > 1.0, -np.inf, a_fl)               # floor satisfied for any rise
127	        a_fl = np.clip(a_fl, a_prof - 12.0 * w, p["heel_rise_max"])
128	        return a_prof + softplus(a_fl - a_prof, w)
129	
130	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- IK
131	    def ik(self, P0, W0, F, ank):
132	        """Analytic two-bone IK.  The knee is a pure flexion about its local x axis; the twist
133	        about the hip-ankle line points the knee's flexion axis along the foot's lateral axis
134	        (the knee tracks over the foot); the ankle takes the remaining rotation.
135	        Returns hip rotation, knee angle, ankle rotation (all local) and the reach q."""
136	        hip = P0 + mv(W0, self.hip_off)
137	        Dp = mtv(W0, ank - hip)
138	        d = np.linalg.norm(Dp, axis=-1)
139	        th, q = self.knee_from_distance(d)
140	        v = self.a + mv(rx(th), self.b)
141	        R1 = rot_between(v, Dp)
142	        n = Dp / d[:, None]
143	        k1 = R1[:, :, 0]                           # knee flexion axis after R1
144	        kd = mtv(W0, F[:, :, 0])                   # the foot's lateral axis
145	        k1p = k1 - np.sum(k1 * n, -1)[:, None] * n
146	        kdp = kd - np.sum(kd * n, -1)[:, None] * n
147	        psi = np.arctan2(np.sum(n * np.cross(k1p, kdp), -1), np.sum(k1p * kdp, -1))
148	        Rh = axis_angle(n, psi) @ R1
149	        Ra = tr(W0 @ Rh @ rx(th)) @ F
150	        return Rh, th, Ra, q
